title: 阪神大賞典の後に・ただちに浮上セヨ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun is unable to pass Narita Brian and ends up losing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After watching Narita Brian walk off with a cool look on her face, she burns with the desire not to let this rivalry end on a loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to beat Narita Brian, she decides her next goal will be the same as hers—the spring Tenno Sho.
